## 6. Glossary

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| **$bootstrap/exe, $bootstrap/properties** | Properties consumed by the bootstrapper: the executable to fetch (package, cipd_version, cmd) and the properties file location plus top-level repo/ref. |
| **$build/chromium_bootstrap** | Property the bootstrapper writes into the launched build: commits used, resolved exe (requested vs actual CIPD version or CAS digest), skip-analysis reasons. |
| **-pgo tag** | A V8 tag <version>-pgo created once profile-guided-optimization data for that version exists; required before the version may be rolled or before lkgr/chromium refs advance. |
| **.dirty_bot_checkout** | Marker file written when bot_update dies mid-checkout; its presence on the next run forces every .git-containing directory under the build dir to be discarded. |
| **@chromium-luci** | The shared Starlark library package (builders, ci, try, builder_config, consoles, gn_args, targets, bootstrap, branches...) hosted in infra/chromium starlark-libs/chromium-luci; replaced infra/config/lib in July 2025. |
| **@chromium-targets** | Local lucicfg package at infra/config/targets declaring tests, binaries, bundles, mixins, variants and suites. |
| **Anomaly / alert / alert group** | A detected step in a timeseries (anomaly) becomes an alert routed by sheriff subscriptions; alerts sharing a revision range and subscription form an alert group, which is the unit that gets a bug. |
| **Auto-Submit** | Gerrit trigger-vote label (+1 'Send CL to CQ automatically after approval') acted on by the chromium-behavior frontend plugin and Rubber Stamper, which vote Commit-Queue+2 on the owner's behalf; CV charges the run quota to the owner. |
| **Auto-triage / auto-bisect** | Dashboard actions enabled per subscription: file the bug automatically after the 20-minute delay; start a Pinpoint bisect automatically (label Chromeperf-Auto-Bisected; opt out with Chromeperf-Auto-BisectOptOut). |
| **Autosharder** | Daily infra builder that computes optimal shard counts from p80 runtimes against a 15-minute target and lands them in autoshard_exceptions.json. |
| **autosharder (infra bucket)** | Daily job that queries BigQuery runtimes (p80) and rewrites infra/config/autoshard_exceptions.json to hit a 15-minute shard runtime, uploading an auto-submit CL; autosharder_test validates such CLs |
| **Basic suite / compound suite / matrix compound suite** | Legacy groupings: a basic suite maps test names to configs; a compound suite is a list of basic suites; a matrix compound suite expands basic suites with variants and mixins. None may nest compound suites. |
| **bbagent** | Buildbucket's agent binary that installs CIPD packages and runs the luciexe; version pinned by git_revision in Buildbucket settings.cfg with a separate version_canary. |
| **bbagent / luciexe** | bbagent is Buildbucket's agent on the bot; it hosts a luciexe (the recipe engine) that reads a Build proto on stdin and streams build.proto updates over LogDog. |
| **Blintz** | Chrome's issue automation (formerly Sheriffbot) that creates merge-request issues, auto-approves simple merges, drives security merges and flags TBD merges. |
| **bootstrapper** | infra/chromium/bootstrapper: a pass-through luciexe (CIPD version 'latest') that fetches the real exe named in $bootstrap/exe, reads the builder's properties.json at the build's revision (patched with the CL), and execs the exe. |
| **bootstrapping** | Running builders through the CIPD 'bootstrapper' luciexe so properties come from the checked-in properties.json at the built revision rather than from cr-buildbucket.cfg. |
| **Bot (Swarming bot)** | One worker process (VM, physical machine or a per-device process on a phone host, e.g. build10-h9--device1) that polls chromium-swarm.appspot.com and runs one task at a time |
| **Bot-Commit** | Gerrit label (+1) that lets bots bypass code review; set via git cl upload --set-bot-commit (V8 release scripts) or by Rubber Stamper. |
| **Bot-Commit / Rubber Stamper** | Bot vote replacing human Code-Review for clean reverts and cherry-picks. |
| **bot_update** | The depot_tools recipe module and its resource script that materialise a gclient solution on a bot at a requested revision, optionally with a Gerrit patch, and report what was checked out. |
| **branch day** | Release-infra procedure run by chrome-branch-day: register chromium-mNNN, run branch-day.py --on-branch on refs/branch-heads/NNNN and branch-day.py on trunk (milestones.json). |
| **Branch gardener** | Rotation covering release-branch (stable/beta) compile and test failures. |
| **Branch number** | The BUILD component at branch point, e.g. 8010 for M153; the branch lives at refs/branch-heads/8010 and DEPS side projects at refs/heads/chromium/8010. |
| **Branch point** | The fixed date when the daily canary build's branch is designated the milestone branch; MAJOR is bumped on trunk the same evening. |
| **branch-heads** | Git namespace refs/branch-heads/*: in chromium/src one per build number (milestone branches are the designated ones, e.g. 8059 = M155); in V8 one per milestone (15.5). |
| **branch_selector** | Argument on LUCI builder/console definitions (branches.selector.MAIN, LINUX_BRANCHES, ALL_BRANCHES ...) that decides whether the resource exists for a given project's platform set. |
| **Bucket** | Namespace of builders with shared ACLs, e.g. chromium/ci, chromium/try; '.shadow' buckets are dynamic buckets used for led builds. |
| **build bucket (chromium.build / chromium.build.fyi)** | Twenty builders measuring Siso/RBE build performance (CQ-shaped, developer-shaped, no-RBE, RBE-instance tests) plus Mac Siso FYI and the Linux Default Remote Build denylist check |
| **build perf builders** | *-build-perf-siso/-developer builders in chromium's build bucket that measure build speed with Siso; not part of chrome.perf. |
| **Build Recipes Tester** | infra/try builder running tools/build's led_recipes_tester recipe: led-launches chromium trybots with the CL's recipe bundle from CAS. |
| **Buildbucket** | Service that tracks builds and queues them into builders; turns a scheduled build into a Swarming task running bbagent. Host cr-buildbucket.appspot.com; CLI 'bb'. |
| **Builder / Build** | A named build configuration in a bucket (dimensions, exe, properties) / one execution of it, identified by a decreasing int64 id and an increasing build number. |
| **Builder / Tester / Processor (perf)** | Perf builder: compiles per commit, uploads isolates to Pinpoint. Tester: one continuously running job per platform that runs the benchmarks for an accumulated commit range across N shards. Processor: a VM that runs the results merge/upload for the heaviest testers (--lightweight). |
| **builder group** | Logical grouping of builders (e.g. chromium.linux) emitted as the builder_group property; keys config lookup, milo consoles, sheriff rotations and one .star file per group. |
| **builder health indicators** | Per-builder thresholds (fail rate, infra fail rate, pending time, build time) in health-specs.json evaluated by cr_builder_health; 'Unhealthy' and 'Low Value' specs. |
| **Builder/tester split (parent/child, thin tester)** | A parent builder compiles and isolates; it triggers a child tester (declared with ci.thin_tester, execution_mode TEST) that only schedules Swarming tasks and collects results, e.g. Linux Builder -> Linux Tests. |
| **builder_spec** | Src-side description of a builder's recipe configuration (gclient_config, chromium_config, execution_mode COMPILE_AND_TEST\|TEST, ...) that becomes $build/chromium_tests_builder_config in properties.json. |
| **builderless / builderful** | builderless:1 bots form a shared pool any builderless builder may use; builderful bots carry a (possibly multi-valued) builder:<name> dimension and serve only those builders |
| **Bundle** | Starlark-only grouping of tests, other bundles and compile targets with mixins, variants and per_test_modifications; every test and legacy suite also defines a same-named bundle. |
| **bundle_recipe** | Go implementation of `recipes.py bundle` (luci-go/recipes_py, CIPD infra/tools/luci/bundle_recipe) that recipes-py invokes at a pinned git_revision. |
| **busy / dead / quarantined / maintenance** | CountBots states: busy = currently running a task; dead = silent longer than bot_death_timeout_secs (default 600 s); quarantined = failed its own health check (needs a human); maintenance = temporary expected self-maintenance (e.g. puppet) |
| **CABE** | cabe.skia.org, 'a performance benchmark A/B experiment analysis service' that computes the statistics for Pinpoint try jobs (GetAnalysis by Pinpoint job id). |
| **Canary / Dev / Beta / Stable** | Release channels in increasing stability: canary ~twice daily from trunk, dev ~weekly, beta after branch, stable three weeks after branch. |
| **cancel_stale / skip_stale_check** | Whether CV cancels a builder's running builds when a substantially different (REWORK) patchset arrives; NO sets skip_stale_check on the tryjob definition. |
| **canned checks** | Reusable checks in depot_tools/presubmit_canned_checks.py (PanProjectChecks, CheckTreeIsOpen, CheckOwners, CheckPatchFormatted…). |
| **CAS (RBE-CAS) / isolate** | Content-addressed storage for test inputs; the builder uploads compiled test bundles and Swarming test tasks fetch them by digest. 'isolate' is the predecessor name. |
| **Change / Commit / GerritPatch / Attempt / Quest (Pinpoint)** | Change = the code state (one Commit per repository + optional patch); Attempt = one full run of the Quests on a Change; Quest = a step such as building on 'Linux Builder Perf' or running a Telemetry story on Swarming. |
| **Chrome Flaky Reproducer (flaky-reproducer bucket)** | Recipe flakiness/reproducer that takes a flaky task/build + test id, tries repeat/batch/parallel strategies and verifies the best reproducing step on CQ/sheriff builders |
| **Chrome for Testing (CfT)** | Non-auto-updating Chrome flavor (is_chrome_for_testing) published for every version of every channel with matching chromedriver and chrome-headless-shell. |
| **chrome-official-brancher** | chrome-official-brancher@chops-service-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com, the release-infra bot that bumps chrome/VERSION, creates branches and rolls side projects on branches. |
| **chrome.perf** | Builder group/console in the internal chrome LUCI project that hosts the perf waterfall (builders, testers, processors). Its test specs are public in chromium/src (testing/buildbot/chromium.perf.json) but its LUCI definitions are internal (//internal/infra/config/subprojects/chrome/ci/chromium.perf.star). |
| **chrome.tests / chrome.tests.finch / chrome.tests.intelligence** | Private test pools on the internal chrome-swarming.appspot.com server used by chrome-project builders whose specs live in waterfalls.pyl; not anonymously countable |
| **chrome_branch_deps.json** | Branch-only file (chrome/chrome_branch_deps.json) created as a milestone branch's first commit, mapping side-project checkouts to their branch refs for the Chrome DEPS-autoroller. |
| **Chromium Updater / Omaha 4** | chrome/updater, the open-source replacement for Google Update (Omaha) and Keystone that speaks the Omaha protocol. |
| **chromium-autoroll@skia-public** | Skia autoroll service account that uploads 'Roll V8 from ... to ...' CLs to chromium/src main (release branches use chromium-release-autoroll). |
| **chromium-behavior** | Gerrit frontend (TypeScript/Lit) plugin for chromium-review implementing Auto-Submit, LGTM catcher, revert/reland buttons, TBR/self-review warnings. |
| **chromium-scoped@luci-project-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com** | LUCI project-scoped identity CV uses to talk to Gerrit and that appears as committer on CV-landed commits (since 2020-11-30). |
| **chromiumdash** | chromiumdash.appspot.com: schedule, branches, releases and commits pages plus JSON APIs (fetch_milestones, fetch_milestone_schedule, fetch_releases, fetch_version, fetch_commit). |
| **ChromiumPerf (master)** | The dashboard 'master' name that chromium.perf maps to in perf_dashboard_machine_group_mapping.json; test paths start with ChromiumPerf/<bot>/<benchmark>/... |
| **ci.builder / ci.thin_tester / try_.builder / try_.orchestrator_builder / try_.compilator_builder / try_.presubmit_builder** | chromium-luci wrappers around luci.builder that add Chromium semantics (defaults, consoles, CQ verifiers, builder_config, gn_args, targets). |
| **ci_only** | Spec flag: run only on CI builders; on try builders the step is skipped unless the Include-Ci-Only-Tests footer is present. |
| **CIPD** | Chrome Infrastructure Package Deployment: registry of binary packages (toolchains, led, lucicfg, recipe bundles, bootstrapper). |
| **CIPD ref vs tag** | A ref (refs/heads/main, latest) is a movable pointer resolved at ensure time and never cached by the client; a tag (git_revision:sha) is an immutable, cacheable label. |
| **CLANG_SUB_REVISION** | Integer suffix on the clang package name (PACKAGE_VERSION = CLANG_REVISION-SUB_REVISION) that must be bumped to re-upload a package for the same LLVM commit. |
| **codesearch bucket** | Eight gen-*-try CQ-includable builders running chromium_codesearch in the try pool to check that Kythe-indexing builds compile; the real indexers live in the infra LUCI project |
| **config set** | LUCI Config unit of import: projects/<id> (from projects.cfg gitiles_location) or services/<id>; each has a latest imported revision and a last import attempt. |
| **Console / list view** | Milo views: consoles order builders against a linear commit history (CI); list views show unordered builds (try). |
| **Content merge** | Gerrit's attempt to auto-merge a path conflict when touched lines do not overlap; otherwise submit fails with 409 'could not be rebased due to a conflict during merge'. |
| **CQ (Commit Queue)** | The set of required trybots a Chromium CL must pass before submission; implemented by LUCI Change Verifier reading commit-queue.cfg. |
| **CQ Dry Run (CQ+1)** | Commit-Queue +1 vote: run the CQ builders and report, without submitting. |
| **CQ modes** | DRY_RUN (CQ+1), FULL_RUN (CQ+2), NEW_PATCHSET_RUN, and Chromium's CQ_MODE_MEGA_DRY_RUN / CQ_MODE_MEGA_FULL_RUN via the Mega-CQ label. |
| **Cq-Do-Not-Cancel-Tryjobs** | CL footer that makes the cancellator leave all of the CL's stale tryjobs running. |
| **cq-usage** | Generated change-detector configs (default.cfg/full.cfg) with restricted OWNERS for changes affecting CQ capacity. |
| **cq_settings** | try_.cq_settings(...) describing a builder's CQ verifier: on_default_cq, includable_only, experiment_percentage, location_filters, disable_reuse, equivalent_builder, ... |
| **CQDaemon** | Legacy Python Commit Queue service replaced by CV in stages (runs 2021-10-01, tryjob execution 2022-09-28, protocol removed 2022-12-15). |
| **Cr-Branched-From** | Footer <parentSha>-<parentRef>@{#N} on branch commits recording where the branch diverged; copied down the branch. |
| **Cr-Commit-Position** | Git footer `refs/heads/main@{#N}` appended at submit time by the **git-numberer Gerrit plugin** (not by any daemon): the child of a parent at position X gets X+1. Paired with Cr-Branched-From on non-main refs, and renamed to Cr-Original-Commit-Position when a numbered commit is cherry-picked. (R15) |
| **Cr-Commit-Position / Cr-Branched-From** | Commit footers written by the commit-numbering daemon: sequential position on a ref, and (on branches) the main commit the branch derives from; parsed by lastchange.py and mergeinfo.py. |
| **Cr-Original-Commit-Position** | Renamed Cr-Commit-Position of a cherry-picked commit, preserved by git-numberer's MessageTweaker. |
| **Crowbar / ssci bucket** | Crowbar is Chromium's declarative third-party vendoring workflow (crowbar.txt fetch/transform/uprev); the ssci bucket's chromium-ssci-linux-amd64 builder triggers those workflows via recipe chromium/crowbar; ssci = the chrome-ssci-team third-party supply-chain security team's builder (expansion not spelled out in-tree) |
| **deapply patch / without patch** | deapply_patch(): rerun bot_update with patch=False, src pinned to the with-patch got_revision and fixed revisions pinned to their got_* values, restoring the base tree and base DEPS for the without-patch compile/test phase. |
| **DEDUPED** | Task state for idempotent tasks whose identical request already succeeded, so Swarming returned the cached result instead of running (210k of chromium.tests' 2.4 M tasks/day) |
| **Dimension / Pool** | key:value attributes a bot advertises (os, cores, gpu, builder, builderless, pool); a pool is a set of bots and a security boundary (luci.chromium.ci, luci.chromium.try, chromium.tests...). |
| **disable_reuse / disable_reuse_footers** | Per-builder CV settings forcing a fresh build every attempt, or whenever a listed footer (Include-Ci-Only-Tests) changes; disable_reuse also marks a builder as 'presubmit' for No-Presubmit. |
| **Early Stable** | The first stable build of a milestone, shipped to a small percentage of users about a week before full stable promotion (since Chrome 110). |
| **equivalent_to** | CV substitution of one builder for another for CL owners in a group (e.g. internal vs public builder). |
| **Exoneration** | ResultDB record that a failed test variant should not block the CL, with reason OCCURS_ON_MAINLINE, OCCURS_ON_OTHER_CLS or NOT_CRITICAL. |
| **experiment_percentage** | Marks a CQ builder experimental: triggered on a percentage of runs and its result never blocks the CL. |
| **Extended Stable** | Enterprise-only Windows/Mac channel that follows every fourth milestone, kept on security refreshes for six extra weeks (new ES milestone every 8 weeks); enabled via TargetChannel policy. |
| **fallback config group** | CV group used when no other group matches a ref; chromium's fallback-cq only runs requires-testing-checker. |
| **fallback-cq** | CQ group watching all refs/branch-heads/* not covered by an active milestone project so Submit-to-CQ works; runs only requires-testing-checker. |
| **Findit** | Legacy Python2 culprit finder (findit-for-me.appspot.com) using heuristics and try-job reruns; its service account still appears in Chromium pool ACLs. |
| **findit bucket / LUCI Bisection** | gofindit-culprit-verification and test-single-revision builders in the 38-bot luci.chromium.findit pool used by LUCI Bisection to verify culprits |
| **Gardener (formerly sheriff)** | On-call Google-employee committer who keeps the tree open and green: reverts, disables tests, uses Owners-Override and Rubber Stamper. |
| **gardener (sheriff) rotation** | Named on-call rotation (chromium, android, chromium.gpu, ...) attached to builders; emitted as gardener_rotations/sheriff_rotations properties, rotation consoles and sheriff-rotations/*.txt. |
| **Gardener / Trooper** | Gardener (formerly sheriff) watches CI rotations for the tree; Trooper is the infra on-call (chrome-ops-client-infra). |
| **gce dimension / golo zone** | gce:1 marks a Google Compute Engine VM (zones like us-central1-a); gce:0 with zone us-{iad,atl,sfo}-golo marks a physical machine in one of three Google-owned labs |
| **generator (lucicfg.generator)** | Callback run after graph construction that can read/modify ctx.output; used by Chromium for cq-usage, cq-builders.md, builder-owners, sort-consoles, validators and outages. |
| **gerrit_rebase_patch_ref** | Default patch mode: cherry-pick target_ref..patch_ref onto the synced base. Disabled by --gerrit_no_rebase_patch_ref (checkout the patch commit directly), which chromium enables only via the Cq-No-Rebase footer on CQ dry runs. |
| **gerrit_reset** | Default post-patch `git reset --soft <base>` so HEAD remains the base commit while the patch is staged; --gerrit_no_reset keeps the cherry-picked commit as HEAD. |
| **git cache / mirror** | A bare repository per URL under [CACHE]/git (e.g. chromium.googlesource.com-chromium-src) maintained by git_cache.py, fetched with +refs/heads/* and bootstrapped from gs://chromium-git-cache snapshots; checkouts are --shared clones of it. |
| **git-numberer** | Chromium's Gerrit plugin with a generator (adds Cr-Commit-Position / Cr-Branched-From at submit) and a verifier (rejects bad numbering, merge commits and non-fast-forward pushes). |
| **git_cache_epoch** | Output property with the unix timestamp stored in <git cache dir>/.cache_epoch when the cache was first created on that bot. |
| **Gitiles poller** | Scheduler trigger that watches repo refs (chromium-gitiles-trigger on refs/heads/main) and emits one trigger per new commit. |
| **gn_args.config** | Named, composable GN argument set; builders reference lists of configs and get a resolved gn-args.json; a builder's own config is named bucket/builder (e.g. ci/Linux Builder). |
| **gn_isolate_map.pyl** | Map from ninja target name to GN label, isolate type (console_test_launcher, windowed_test_launcher, generated_script, script, additional_compile_target), module_scheme and extra args; generated from binaries.star. |
| **got_cr_revision** | Property for the chromium/src revision on builders (show_v8_revision config) where got_revision has been repointed at src/v8. |
| **got_revision / got_<x>_revision** | Output properties giving the HEAD commit of src (or of the repo mapped by got_revision_reverse_mapping, e.g. src/v8 for got_v8_revision) after the sync; got_revision is by definition the build's output commit. |
| **got_revision_cp** | The Cr-Commit-Position footer of that HEAD, e.g. refs/heads/main@{#1702393}; parsed by commit_position.parse into Build.output.gitiles_commit.ref/position. |
| **has_native_resultdb_integration** | Mixin telling the recipe the harness uploads to ResultSink itself, so result_adapter must not wrap it. |
| **importAllConfigsInterval** | 10-minute period of LUCI Config's import-configs cron; each config set's task is offset deterministically inside it (DistributeOffset). |
| **includable_only** | CQ verifier flag meaning the builder only runs when opted in via Cq-Include-Trybots; 467 of 603 chromium verifiers. |
| **infra-packager-*** | Internal infra/infra builders that build and upload production CIPD packages on every commit with tags luci_build/git_repository/git_revision and -ref latest. |
| **infra_step** | Recipe step flag: a failing infra step is painted EXCEPTION (purple) and raises InfraFailure, giving the build INFRA_FAILURE status, which tree closers ignore; bot_update runs with infra_step=True. |
| **Invocation** | ResultDB container of results (build, swarming task, CQ attempt); composable; immutable once FINALIZED. |
| **is_chrome_branded** | GN arg selecting Google Chrome branding/assets, which require the src-internal checkout. |
| **is_official_build** | GN arg enabling the shipping optimization level (ThinLTO, PGO, symbol_level 2, real LASTCHANGE); unrelated to branding. |
| **Isolate / CAS** | The set of runtime_deps files plus command, described by a .isolate file, uploaded with `isolate batcharchive` to Content-Addressed Storage; its digest is passed as swarm_hashes. |
| **LASTCHANGE** | build/util/LASTCHANGE, generated by lastchange.py as <hash>-<commit position>; LASTCHANGE.dummy (all zeros) is used for non-official reproducible builds. |
| **led** | 'LUCI editor' CLI in depot_tools: get-builder\|get-build\|get-swarm -> edit-* -> launch a JobDefinition into Swarming (shadow buckets). |
| **led edit-recipe-bundle** | led subcommand that bundles the local recipe repo, uploads it to CAS and either replaces the job payload or, for bootstrapped builders, sets led_cas_recipe_bundle. |
| **LKGR** | Last Known Good Revision: refs/heads/lkgr in V8, maintained every 6 minutes by the 'V8 lkgr finder' builder; the candidate that auto_push.py turns into a release. |
| **location_filters** | Per-builder path regexps (with exclude flag) deciding whether a builder runs for the files a CL touches; basis of path-based/optional builders. |
| **LogDog** | Streaming log service (Butler -> Pub/Sub -> Collector -> BigTable -> Archivist -> GCS); Chromium instance logs.chromium.org, archive bucket chromium-luci-logdog. |
| **LTC / LTS (ChromeOS)** | Long-term support candidate and release channels for ChromeOS, cut every six months from specific milestones (M144, M150, M160), which keeps those branches alive longer. |
| **LUCI** | 'Layered Universal Continuous Integration': the set of independently deployed Google-Cloud CI services (Buildbucket, Swarming, Scheduler, Milo, LogDog, ResultDB, CV, Notify, Analysis, Bisection, CIPD, Config) that replaced Buildbot for Chromium. |
| **LUCI Analysis** | Flake clustering service; known flaky failures are exonerated by the recipe. |
| **LUCI Analysis (ex-Weetbix)** | Failure clustering, impact metrics, auto bug filing and test-stability (QueryStability) service that drives CQ exoneration. Host luci-analysis.appspot.com. |
| **LUCI Bisection** | chromium's correctness culprit finder (infra/config/luci-bisection.cfg: compile and test analysis, nth-section, auto-revert) - unrelated to Pinpoint. |
| **LUCI Bisection (GoFindit)** | Go rewrite of Findit that runs nth-section bisection on findit/* builders for compile and test failures and can create/submit reverts. |
| **LUCI CV (Change Verifier)** | The CQ: watches Gerrit Commit-Queue votes, runs tryjob verifiers per commit-queue.cfg, and submits CLs. Status host chromium-cq-status.appspot.com. |
| **LUCI Notify** | Sends build-status emails and opens/closes trees (tree_closers) based on failed-step regexps; Chromium's tree host chromium-status.appspot.com. |
| **LUCI Scheduler** | Service running gitiles pollers (triggers) and jobs; converts commits into Buildbucket builds via triggering policies (GREEDY_BATCHING etc.). Host luci-scheduler.appspot.com. |
| **luci.buildbucket.canary_software** | Experiment (from task_template_canary_percentage) that makes a build use the canary bbagent/cipd/agent package versions; 5% on chromium try builders. |
| **luci.chromium.provenance.ci** | 4-bot pool 'dedicated for spike provenance' hosting the 3pp/androidx packagers and the ssci builder |
| **luci.chromium.try.orchestrator** | A planned pool for src-less orchestrator try builders; named only in try.shadow constraints, all opt-ins commented out, zero bots |
| **lucicfg** | LUCI's Starlark interpreter/generator that turns *.star into LUCI service *.cfg protobuf-text files and validates them against the LUCI Config service. |
| **lucicfg / LUCI Config** | Starlark-to-.cfg generator and the config service (config.luci.app / luci-config.appspot.com) that validates and serves project configs. |
| **lucicfg validate** | Regenerates configs, checks the on-disk output is fresh, and sends each config set to LUCI Config's ValidateConfigs RPC; run by depot_tools' CheckLucicfgGenOutput in presubmit. |
| **Magic substitution** | An arg literal $$MAGIC_SUBSTITUTION_<Fn> replaced at generation time by a Python function that inspects the test/tester config (GPU ids, CrOS filters, etc.). |
| **manifest** | JSON map path -> {repository, revision} for every git repo in the checkout, built from `gclient revinfo -a --ignore-dep-type cipd --output-json`; exposed as Result.manifest and as the TurboCI BotUpdateResults manifest. |
| **MB (meta-build)** | tools/mb/mb.py: wraps gn gen/analyze, resolves a builder to GN args (starlark gn-args.json or mb_config.pyl), and writes .isolate files and swarming command lines. |
| **Mega CQ** | Additional CV modes (Mega-CQ+1 label with CQ+1/+2) that launch mega-cq-launcher, which triggers trybot mirrors of all gardened CI builders. |
| **Mega-CQ** | Alternative CQ modes (CQ_MODE_MEGA_DRY_RUN/FULL_RUN, Gerrit label Mega-CQ) that run the trybot mirrors of all gardened CI builders. |
| **Merge-Request / Merge fields** | Issue-tracker fields driving cherry-pick approvals; Merge values are Pending, Review-###, Approved-###, Merged-###, Rejected-###, TBD-###, NA-###. |
| **Milestone (MNNN)** | A major version of Chrome (MAJOR in chrome/VERSION); one ships to stable every two weeks since M153. |
| **Milo** | The LUCI UI (ci.chromium.org / luci-milo.appspot.com) rendering builds, builders, consoles and test results from Buildbucket and ResultDB. |
| **MinEquivalentPatchset** | Earliest patchset code-wise equivalent to the current one, computed from Gerrit revision kinds; only REWORK advances it. |
| **mini_installer** | Chromium's Windows installer executable; embeds setup.ex_ and chrome.packed.7z as resources listed in packed_files.rc generated by create_installer_archive.py. |
| **Mirror** | Try builders declare mirrors = [ci builders]; they inherit the union of the mirrored CI builders' targets and their gn_args config (ci/<name>). |
| **mirrors** | Try-builder argument naming the CI builders whose builder_spec/targets it reuses; every CQ builder must mirror a gardened CI builder. |
| **Mixin** | Reusable fragment of test configuration (args, swarming dims, resultdb, ci_only, ...) applied at test, variant, waterfall or builder level; args extend, dimensions update, other keys overwrite. |
| **mode_allowlist** | CV run modes in which a builder participates; defaults to FULL_RUN and DRY_RUN. |
| **no_fetch_tags** | Root-repo-only switch (--no-fetch-tags to populate, git fetch --no-tags) that chromium_checkout enables for every Chromium build because Chromium's tag count slows fetches. |
| **no_history / shallow** | --depth 1 (no history) or --shallow (10000 commits) for the root mirror and DEPS repos; exposed to bots in May 2026 for thin testers. |
| **NO_RESOURCE** | Swarming task state meaning no bot matching the requested dimensions existed when the task (slice) was created; surfaced in Buildbucket as INFRA_FAILURE 'Task did not start, no resource' |
| **NOAUTOREVERT=true** | Commit-message flag that stops LUCI Bisection from auto-reverting a CL. |
| **nontrivial roll** | A roll that changes expectation files but trains cleanly; uploaded as a CQ dry run with Auto-Submit+1 and owners as reviewers, requiring human approval. |
| **Omaha** | Google's update protocol and (formerly) Windows client; google/omaha archived 2025-08-04. |
| **Orchestrator / compilator** | CQ variant of the split: the user-facing orchestrator (linux-rel) triggers a compilator (linux-rel-compilator) that compiles, isolates and runs checkout-bound tests, then the orchestrator runs swarmed tests. |
| **outages config** | outages/config.star switches (e.g. disable_cq_experiments) applied last by generators, guarded by presubmit footers Infra-Config-Outage-Action / Infra-Config-Ignore-Outage. |
| **owner_whitelist_group** | CV restriction: builder is only triggered if the CL owner belongs to one of the listed auth groups. |
| **Owners-Override** | Gerrit label that bypasses OWNERS enforcement; restricted to gardeners, RPMs, LSC/global approvers, ATLs. |
| **PACKAGE.star / PACKAGE.lock** | lucicfg package declaration (name, min lucicfg, entry points, deps pinned to googlesource revisions) and its generated resolution lock file. |
| **Parent / child tester (builder/tester split)** | CI pattern: a compiling parent (e.g. Linux Builder) triggers a thin tester (Linux Tests) via Scheduler with parent_* properties. |
| **parent_got_revision** | Property set on child testers by trigger_child_builds: the parent's got_revision (and parent_got_* for every got_*), alongside deps_revision_overrides and a GitilesTrigger at the parent's output commit. |
| **patch_ref** | A `repo@target_ref:fetch_ref` triple (e.g. https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src@refs/heads/main:refs/changes/48/8420748/2) telling gclient which Gerrit ref to apply, to which local repo, and which branch it targets. |
| **patch_root** | The checkout-relative path of the repo that receives the patch (from gclient.get_gerrit_patch_root via repo_path_map, e.g. src or src/v8); reported in the JSON output and as mounts_to_apply in TurboCI. |
| **Perf on CQ** | Experimental (non-blocking) CQ layer since July 2025: chrome/try/linux-perf-trigger and win-perf-trigger run on every default-CQ CL as 100%-experimental verifiers and, for selected CLs, create 'CQ Perf' Pinpoint try jobs (origin=CQ) on linux-perf-cq/win-perf-cq whose results appear in Gerrit's Checks tab. |
| **Perf regression sheriff / perfbot health sheriff** | Former human rotations (regressions vs. bot health); their docs were removed in 2024 and 2022 and Chromium states in July 2026 that they no longer exist. |
| **Performance Dashboard / chromeperf** | chromeperf.appspot.com, the legacy Python App Engine dashboard (catapult/dashboard) that stores timeseries, detects anomalies, files bugs and hosts Pinpoint; now login-gated and being replaced by Skia Perf. |
| **pin / fixed revision** | A revision explicitly passed as --revision name@value; a pin is a fixed revision that is a commit hash. fixed_revisions are echoed in the JSON output and pinned again on the without-patch sync. |
| **Pinpoint** | 'Regression Explorer' at pinpoint-dot-chromeperf.appspot.com: runs Jobs (Quests Build/Test/Get values over Changes, in Attempts) for bisection (comparison_mode performance/functional) or A/B try jobs (comparison_mode try); descends into DEPS'd repositories. A Go/Temporal re-implementation ('Pairwise' jobs, Culprit Finder) lives in skia buildbot. |
| **Pinpoint-only platform** | A tester configuration (e.g. linux-perf-pgo, win-11-perf-pgo) that exists for Pinpoint jobs only and is not scheduled on the waterfall. |
| **Polymorphic launcher** | chromium-luci pattern: one launcher builder (recipe chromium_polymorphic/launcher) triggers a runner builder with runner_builder/target_builders properties instead of cloning each target builder's config |
| **populate** | `git cache populate`: (re)bootstrap the mirror if needed, reset its fetch config, and fetch the configured refspecs plus explicitly requested --commit/--ref values. |
| **precommit_args / non_precommit_args** | Args added only on try builders (e.g. Skia Gold Gerrit issue/patchset) or only on CI. |
| **PRESUBMIT.py** | Per-directory Python hooks run by git cl (upload/commit) and by presubmit builders; functions named Check* with *Upload/*Commit suffixes under PRESUBMIT_VERSION 2.0.0. |
| **projects.cfg** | LUCI Config's registry of tenant projects (id + gitiles_location); for Chrome infra it lives in the internal infradata/config repo and must list chromium-mNNN before a branch config can validate. |
| **pRPC** | LUCI's JSON-over-HTTP RPC convention: POST /prpc/<service>/<method> with Content-Type and Accept application/json; responses start with the XSSI guard )]}' |
| **Publish DEPS** | Historical (through M116, 2023) tag-only commit that replaced floating branch refs in a release branch's DEPS with pinned hashes; superseded by fully pinned branch DEPS plus chrome_branch_deps.json. |
| **Realm** | ACL scope in realms.cfg binding roles (buildbucket.*, resultdb.*, analysis.*, scheduler.*, treestatus.*, swarming.*) to groups; buckets and pools map to realms. |
| **REBASE_ALWAYS** | Gerrit submit type that always rebases the patchset onto the branch tip at submit, creating a new patchset and appending submit footers; required for Change Message Modifier plugins to run. |
| **Recipe / recipe bundle** | Python-embedded DSL from recipes-py defining build steps; Chromium's live in chromium/tools/build and ship as CIPD package infra/recipe_bundles/chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/tools/build. |
| **recipe autoroller** | Internal builder (account recipe-mega-autoroller@chops-service-accounts, group infra-internal/recipe-rollers) running infra's recipe_autoroller recipe every 10 minutes across recipe repos. |
| **recipe bundle** | A CIPD package (infra/recipe_bundles/<host>/<repo>) containing a recipe repo, all its recipes.cfg dependencies and gitattribute-tagged helpers plus `recipes`/`luciexe` entry scripts, so a build can run recipes without git; tagged git_revision:<sha>, ref refs/heads/main. |
| **Recipe-Tryjob-Bypass-Reason** | Commit-message footer that turns the downstream roll tryjob green without analysis; the autoroller stamps 'Autoroller'. |
| **recipe_bundler** | Go tool (infra/tools/luci/recipe_bundler) driven by the infra recipe_bundler.py recipe on an internal builder; fetches repos, runs recipes.py fetch/bundle and cipd create/set-ref. |
| **`recipes` gitattribute** | Git attribute that adds (or with -recipes removes) files from the bundle beyond the default recipes/, recipe_modules/, recipe_proto/ trees. |
| **Refresh** | A weekly stable/extended-stable update within a milestone (PATCH bump), mostly security fixes. |
| **refs/branch-heads/NNNN** | Git ref namespace for every trunk build's branch; first commit is 'Create chrome_branch_deps.json for branch NNNN'; fetched with gclient --with_branch_heads. |
| **Release manager / TPM** | Members of the release management team (release engineers and technical program managers) who own blockers and merge approvals; listed per platform on chromiumdash's schedule page. |
| **ReleaseBlock:Dev/Beta/Stable** | Issue-tracker field marking a bug as blocking shipping to that channel (and all later ones) for a given Milestone and OS. |
| **ResultDB / ResultSink / rdb** | Test result store with invocations, test results, exonerations; ResultSink is the local pRPC proxy started by 'rdb stream' and found via LUCI_CONTEXT. |
| **ResultDB / ResultSink / rdb stream** | LUCI test-result store; ResultSink is the local proxy launched by `rdb stream`, addressed via LUCI_CONTEXT; result_adapter converts gtest/json outputs for harnesses without native integration. |
| **retry_config** | CV quota for retrying failed tryjobs (single_quota, global_quota, weights for failure/transient/timeout). |
| **Reuse window** | Freshness bound for reusable builds: 24 h from build creation by default, or ReuseWindow.max_commit_distance commits behind the branch tip when configured. |
| **ReuseKey** | sha256 of (CL id, MinEquivalentPatchset, disable_reuse footer values) stored on each Tryjob; equal keys let a later Run reuse the build. |
| **Robocrop** | The GCE-provider autoscaler configured in the internal infradata/config repo with min_amount/max_amount per bot group; the reason chromium.tests swings by thousands of bots |
| **roll ref (refs/heads/roll)** | V8 ref force-pushed by the detect_roll_candidate recipe to the newest tagged version that has PGO data; the Skia autoroller rolls this ref into Chromium's DEPS. |
| **RTS** | Regression test selection experiment (chromium_rts.filter_file_analysis) that skips tests unlikely to be affected by a CL. |
| **Rubber Stamper** | rubber-stamper@appspot.gserviceaccount.com, a bot that votes Bot-Commit+1 on benign changes (clean cherry-picks within 14 days, roll-merge hashtag). |
| **Run** | One CV attempt for a CL in a mode (DRY_RUN, FULL_RUN, NEW_PATCHSET_RUN, CQ_MODE_MEGA_*), identified as <project>/<inverseTS>-1-<hash>; lifecycle PENDING -> RUNNING -> WAITING_FOR_SUBMISSION -> SUBMITTING -> ended. |
| **Run / attempt** | One CV execution for a CL in a given mode (DRY_RUN, FULL_RUN, NEW_PATCHSET_RUN, CQ_MODE_MEGA_*), visible at luci-change-verifier.appspot.com/ui/run/chromium/… |
| **Sandwich verification** | A Cloud-Workflows/CABE step that re-runs an A/B (Regression Verification try job, 30 attempts) before or after a bisect to confirm the regression or the culprit is real; skipped for culprits inside DEPS rolls. |
| **Script test** | Legacy local test in testing/scripts implementing run/compile_targets subcommands via common.run_script; discouraged, runs on the builder itself. |
| **settings.json / milestones.json** | infra/config inputs: settings.json describes the current project/ref/platforms; milestones.json (main only) lists active milestone projects and refs. |
| **shadow bucket** | Dynamic bucket (ci.shadow, try.shadow) into which led builds of a real bucket's builders are redirected, with shadow_builder_adjustments (pool, service account, properties). |
| **shadow bucket / shadow_builder_adjustments** | Per-builder overrides (pool, service account, dimensions) applied when a led/shadow build of that builder is created; ci builders shadow into luci.chromium.try, producing 642 extra pool lines |
| **Shard** | One Swarming task running 1/N of a suite, selected via GTEST_SHARD_INDEX/GTEST_TOTAL_SHARDS; results are merged by a merge script. |
| **Sheriff (dashboard sense)** | A subscription in chromeperf-sheriffs.cfg (name, rules over test paths, anomaly thresholds, bug components, auto_triage/auto_merge/auto_bisection) - not necessarily a human rotation. |
| **Sheriff-o-Matic (SoM)** | Gardener alert dashboard (sheriff-o-matic.appspot.com) that queries builder_group/sheriff_rotations properties. |
| **Size CQ gates** | android-binary-size, compile-size and fuchsia-binary-size, required CQ builders that fail on size growth unless a Binary-Size:/Compile-Size:/Fuchsia-Binary-Size: footer justifies it; the only blocking 'performance-adjacent' checks in the CQ. |
| **Skia Perf** | Go/TypeScript performance dashboard from the Skia project; since 2023 the unification target for Chrome. Public instance perf.luci.app (chrome-public-spanner), internal chrome-perf.corp.goog. |
| **Skip-Performance-Test** | Commit-message footer emitted (value 'false') by the V8 autoroller since 2025-08-22 via the AutoRoller ExtraFooters hook, replacing an explicit Cq-Include-Trybots of the perf-trigger builder; consumed by the internal Perf-on-CQ trigger recipe, not by the waterfall, LUCI Bisection or Pinpoint's public API. |
| **Skylab** | ChromeOS lab test scheduling (via cros_test_platform); specs carry cros_board, dut_pool, autotest_name, shard_level_retries_on_ctp instead of Swarming dims. |
| **Stable cut / Early Stable cut** | Days when the (early) stable release-candidate build is generated from the branch; stable blockers must be fixed by early stable cut. |
| **Subdevice / shard** | One Swarming task of a tester run, pinned to a lab device via perf_device_trigger.py's soft device affinity; the checked-in <tester>_map.json decides which benchmarks/stories each shard runs. |
| **Submit to CQ (CQ+2)** | Commit-Queue +2 vote: run the CQ builders, check tree status, and submit on success. |
| **submit_options (max_burst / burst_delay)** | CV rate limit on successful submissions per project; chromium: 2 per 60 s. |
| **SubmitQueue** | Per-LUCI-project datastore entity serialising submissions: one Current run, a FIFO waitlist and a History of successful submission times used for burst limiting. |
| **swarm_hashes** | Build property {isolate name: CAS digest} produced by the isolate step and handed to child testers with swarming_command_lines_digest/cwd. |
| **Swarming** | Stateless AppEngine task scheduler with self-updating bots; matches task dimensions to bot dimensions with a 0-255 priority queue. Host chromium-swarm.appspot.com. |
| **Swarming pool** | A named collection of Swarming bots that is also a security boundary (who may view/trigger tasks); builders name it with the pool dimension, test tasks default to chromium.tests |
| **targets.bundle / mixin / variant** | Starlark test-spec building blocks: bundles group tests and compile targets; mixins modify test specs (args, swarming dims, shards); variants expand a test into several configurations. |
| **Test Executable API** | The isolated_scripts contract: --isolated-outdir, --isolated-script-test-output/-filter/-filter-file/-launcher-retry-limit/-repeat, shard env vars, exit codes 0/1/2/130. |
| **Test Reviver (reviver bucket)** | Polymorphic launcher/runner pair that rebuilds a CI builder off-peak and runs its disabled tests to find ones that now pass; results in chrome-luci-data.chromium.reviver_test_results |
| **test_id_prefix / module_name / module_scheme** | ResultDB identity fields emitted per test: 'ninja://<label>/', the GN label, and the id scheme (gtest, webtest, junit, single, flat...). |
| **test_suite_exceptions.pyl** | Per-bot remove_from / modifications / replacements applied last; cannot add tests. |
| **thin tester** | Child CI builder (execution_mode TEST) triggered by a parent builder; runs tests on swarming from small Linux machines (e.g. Linux Tests). |
| **tracked_files** | lucicfg.config glob list of the generated files lucicfg owns; only these are written and stale ones deleted. |
| **tree closer** | luci.tree_closer that flips chromium-status.appspot.com to closed when a tree-closing builder fails a step matching the tree-closing regexp. |
| **Tree status** | Open/closed/throttled/maintenance state for the 'chromium' tree at chromium-status.appspot.com (LUCI Tree Status); CV and PRESUBMIT gate landing on it. |
| **Tree status (LUCI Tree Status)** | OPEN/CLOSED/THROTTLED/MAINTENANCE state of tree 'chromium' (derived from chromium-status.appspot.com); CV submits when OPEN or THROTTLED unless No-Tree-Checks. |
| **TREE_CLOSING_STEPS_REGEXP** | \b(bot_update\|compile\|gclient runhooks\|generate_build_files\|runhooks\|update\|\w*nocompile_test)\b in infra/config/notifiers.star; luci-notify closes the tree when a FAILURE build has a FAILURE step matching it. |
| **Tricium** | Analyzer trybots (clang-tidy, metrics, oilpan) run in NEW_PATCHSET_RUN mode that post lint comments to Gerrit. |
| **Trivial rebase** | Gerrit revision kind TRIVIAL_REBASE(_WITH_MESSAGE_UPDATE): same diff including context lines after a conflict-free rebase; keeps CV's reuse key and does not trigger stale-tryjob cancellation. |
| **trivial roll** | An autoroller roll of recipes.cfg pins that produces no expectation changes (`recipes.py test run` passes); self-approved with Bot-Commit+1 and CQ'd automatically. |
| **Trooper** | Chrome Ops client-infra on-call for infrastructure (not code) failures. |
| **trusted.robots / Lexan TBI** | Bucket and 2-bot pool for trusted toolchain builds; the recipe calls lexan_tbi_client to request a Clang build inside the Lexan trusted-build instance rather than compiling locally |
| **Tryjob** | CV's record of one Buildbucket build used to verify a Run; statuses PENDING, TRIGGERED, ENDED, CANCELLED, UNTRIGGERED; may be LaunchedBy one Run and ReusedBy others. |
| **Tryjob / trybot** | A build of a try builder against a CL; required, path-based (location_filters), includable-only (Cq-Include-Trybots) or experimental (experiment_percentage). |
| **Tryjob Executor** | CV component (cv/internal/tryjob/execute) that computes requirements, reuses or launches builds, retries and decides Run success. |
| **TurboCI** | Emerging LUCI orchestration layer (work plans of checks/stages) visible in 2026 via luci.buildbucket.run_in_turboci and role/turboci.nodeReaderExternal; public docs sparse. |
| **TurboCI SOURCE check** | A CHECK_KIND_SOURCE node ('checkout' / 'checkout (without patch)') created PLANNED with GobSourceCheckOptions before bot_update runs and finalized with GobSourceCheckResults + BotUpdateResults afterwards; the compile BUILD check depends on it. |
| **unmanaged** | gclient revision value that makes it skip updating a solution; bot_update passes --revision src@unmanaged because it has already positioned the root repo. |
| **user_limits** | CV per-principal caps on concurrently active runs (default 10 in chromium). |
| **UTR** | tools/utr: developer tool that replays a builder's compile-and-test for one suite on Swarming. |
| **v8-ci-autoroll-builder** | v8-ci-autoroll-builder@chops-service-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com, the V8 bot that lands Version x.y.z commits, patch bumps, branch-cut minor bumps and tags. |
| **V8_IS_CANDIDATE_VERSION** | Macro in v8-version.h set to 1 on main and 0 on release branches; the create_release SetVersion step writes new_candidate=0. |
| **Variant** | Named modification with an identifier that expands one test into several steps ('test_name identifier'), e.g. iOS simulator versions or GPU models. |
| **Waterfall / builder group** | Historical name for a grouping of builders (e.g. chromium.linux); each group gets one <group>.json of test specs, either legacy in //testing/buildbot or generated per builder under infra/config/generated/builders. |
| **waterfalls.pyl** | Legacy hand-written //testing/buildbot test configuration, still used by 16 builder groups; being replaced by starlark targets. |
| **Zucchini / bsdiff** | Binary diff tools used by create_installer_archive.py to build differential installers (chrome_patch_<new>_from_<old>.packed.7z). |

## 7. Figure plan

Fourteen figures, each specified as *what it shows* → *which data it draws on* (ledger IDs, excerpt IDs `X#`, and rows of the Numbers/Timeline tables). Sized for a 10,000-word illustrated explainer: F1–F3 carry the architecture, F4–F8 the two hot paths, F9–F11 the scale, F12–F14 the release half.

**F1 — The four pipelines on one substrate.**
A single landscape diagram with four horizontal lanes (pre-submit, post-submit, performance, release) crossing five vertical service columns (Gerrit, LUCI CV, Buildbucket, Swarming/CAS, ResultDB + LUCI Analysis), with side channels to Milo, LogDog, LUCI Notify and LUCI Bisection. Every box is annotated with its appspot host from `main.star` and the repo that implements it (luci-go, luci-py, catapult, infra/infra). The point of the figure is that the performance lane leaves the `chromium` project for the internal `chrome` project at the Buildbucket column. Data: LS1–LS12, LS19, LS36–LS39, LS70–LS78, IC12, PF1, PF65, excerpt of `main.star` `luci.project(...)`.

**F2 — "The tree configures the fleet": the lucicfg pipeline as a funnel.**
Left: the inputs — `PACKAGE.star` (with the `@chromium-luci` pin `3c067cfc` and the local `@chromium-targets` package), `settings.json`, `milestones.json`, 125 `.star` files / 76,580 lines. Middle: lucicfg 1.46.7 and the three execution stages (build graph → check consistency → run generators). Right: the `tracked_files` manifest as an exploded list of outputs with their sizes — cr-buildbucket.cfg 139,286 lines / 5,544,282 bytes, commit-queue.cfg 9,451, luci-milo.cfg 31,964, luci-scheduler.cfg 7,092, luci-notify.cfg 6,013, realms.cfg 933, plus `generated/builders/` 1,146 directories. Data: IC2, IC6–IC11, IC19, IC89, IC100, IC105, IC106, IC108, IC110, IC113, V15, Numbers rows for every size.

**F3 — One builder, expanded.**
A two-column "before/after" figure: on the left the ~20-line Starlark call for `ci/Linux Builder` (excerpt, `chromium.linux.star:328-378`); on the right every artefact lucicfg emits from it — the cr-buildbucket builder block with its seven dimensions and the bootstrapper `exe`, the scheduler job, four console entries, the tree-closer notifier, the health spec, the owner line, and the four per-builder files (`properties.json`, `shadow-properties.json`, `gn-args.json`, `targets/chromium.linux.json`). Arrows labelled with the defaults each field inherited from `ci.defaults`. Data: IC51–IC55, IC60–IC69, IC124, IC152, TB51, TB53, excerpts of the builder block and `gn-args.json`.

**F4 — The commit path as a state machine, developer keystroke to `refs/heads/main`.**
A single long swimlane: workstation (`git cl upload` → presubmit → `refs/for/main%l=Commit-Queue+2`), Gerrit (submit requirements, Auto-Submit plugin rewriting CR+1 into CQ+2), CV (trigger finder → PENDING → RUNNING → WAITING_FOR_SUBMISSION → SUBMITTING → SUCCEEDED), Gerrit again (REBASE_ALWAYS → new patchset → git-numberer footer), and the post-submit poller. Each transition labelled with its source file. Data: CP1–CP12, CP33–CP38, SM39–SM47, SM57, SM72–SM78, SM80–SM86, SM91–SM97, V16, excerpts of `storage.proto` run states and the git-numberer README rules.

**F5 — Tryjob reuse and cancellation: the ReuseKey decision tree.**
A decision diagram: new Run → for each definition, is `disable_reuse` set? → search CV datastore by ReuseKey → search Buildbucket → three-valued reusability (may/yes/no) → time window 24 h *or* `max_commit_distance` 800 → launch. A side panel shows the Gerrit revision-kind ladder (NO_CHANGE … TRIVIAL_REBASE_WITH_MESSAGE_UPDATE keep the key; REWORK breaks it) and a second panel the cancellation rule (patchset change cancels the Run; only a REWORK cancels the builds). Annotate with the worked example: CL 8423730, 32 of 34 tryjobs reused after 14.4 hours. Data: SM1–SM20, SM22–SM37, V8, Numbers rows for 24 h / 800 / 12 disable_reuse builders.

**F6 — Inside one CQ build: the four-phase retry ladder.**
A time-ordered column chart of the phases `(with patch)` → `(retry shards with patch)` → `(without patch)`, showing which tasks are re-run in each (all shards, failed shard indices only, each failing test × 10 with `retry_limit 0`), the ≤100-test guard, and the truth table that decides a failure ("failed with patch AND failed on retry AND passed without patch"). Overlay the exoneration path into LUCI Analysis. Caption carries the "~20,000 unique flaky tests" figure. Data: CP43, CP46, TB110–TB118, LS75–LS86, IC142, excerpt of `cq.md:243-262`.

**F7 — bot_update, the three-layer sandwich.**
Three stacked bands — recipe module, `bot_update.py`, depot_tools — with the actual command sequence from the live `ci/Linux Builder #228485` log running down the middle: `git cat-file -e <pin>` → `git cache populate --reset-fetch-config --no-fetch-tags --commit <pin> --ref refs/heads/main` (0.2 min) → `git clone --no-checkout --local --shared` → `git fetch origin <pin>` → `git checkout --force` (66 s) → `git clean -dff` → `gclient sync --revision src@unmanaged` (3.5 min) → `gclient revinfo` (0.4 min), total 5 min 17 s. A try-build inset shows `--patch_ref`, the cherry-pick and the soft reset, with the arrow that explains why `got_revision` is the base commit. Data: BU1–BU22, BU30–BU45, BU51–BU58, excerpts of the populate command and `apply_patch_ref`.

**F8 — Two authorities for one shard count.**
A small, high-impact figure: `chromium.linux.star:681-696` (`shards = 20`) on the left, `autoshard_exceptions.json` in the middle (`browser_tests: {shards: 70, try_builder: linux-rel}`), the generated `targets/chromium.linux.json` on the right (`"shards": 70`), and beneath it the autosharder loop — daily 09:00 UTC, 14-day BigQuery window, p80, ≥1,500 samples, `ceil(shards × (runtime − overhead) / (15 min − overhead))` floored at 1, rubber-stamped auto-submit CL. This figure exists to stop the 20-vs-70 contradiction recurring in the prose. Data: LS41, IC55, TB68–TB72, V12, V20, V21, C07, R11.

**F9 — The fleet, to scale.**
A proportional area chart of the Swarming pools on 2026-09-22T09:45–09:55Z: test pools `chromium.tests` 20,320–20,694 (13,180 GCE / 7,395 physical), `chromium.tests.avd` 3,761–3,814, `chromium.tests.gpu` 3,266 (3,118 physical), and the small tail; builder pools `luci.chromium.try` 2,113, `ci` 590, `gpu.ci` 351, `gpu.try` 287. Each block split GCE vs physical and, for the GPU pool, by vendor (Intel 548 / NVIDIA 391 / AMD 380 / Apple 370 / Qualcomm 159). A ghost outline shows the 24,172 reading from the previous afternoon, with a caption on Robocrop autoscaling. Data: FL25–FL28, FL39–FL47, V6, Numbers fleet rows.

**F10 — A day of work: 2.4 million tasks.**
A Sankey from the four largest pools into the settled StateQuery buckets for the 24 h to 2026-09-22T09:59:47Z: `chromium.tests` 2,417,399 created → COMPLETED 2,364,471 (2,329,117 success / 35,354 failure), DEDUPED 210,323, KILLED 40,246, CANCELED 10,288, TIMED_OUT 1,386, EXPIRED 545, BOT_DIED 139, NO_RESOURCE 324. The figure must be drawn with overlapping-bucket semantics stated in the caption (DEDUPED is a form of COMPLETED; the buckets sum to 2,627,722, not 2,417,399). An inset column shows the `luci.chromium.ci` NO_RESOURCE incident: 150, 171, 432, 731, 602, 4,674, 26,001 over seven consecutive days. Data: FL51–FL55, V5, V6, C04.

**F11 — The eighteen buckets, sized and labelled.**
A treemap of `cr-buildbucket.cfg` by bucket (ci 641, try 500, build 20, webrtc.fyi 14, reviver 12, codesearch 8, webrtc 8, findit 2, infra 2, trusted.robots 2, flaky-reproducer 1, ssci 1, six empty `.shadow`), with ci and try exploded into their builder groups (chromium.gpu.fyi 74, chromium.dawn 60, chromium.android 58, …, tryserver.chromium.android 106, .linux 83, .mac 72, .win 49) and the group-less builders shown as a hatched remainder (ci 6, try 9). Each minor bucket carries a one-line role caption. Data: IC100, IC102, CP80, V14, FL57–FL80.

**F12 — Release cadence, the 2026 seam.**
A Gantt chart of M150→M160 showing branch point, beta, early stable, stable and weekly refreshes, with the four-week rhythm on the left, the two-week rhythm from M153 on the right, the Extended Stable band highlighted on M152/M156/M160, and the holiday stretch on M159/M160. A second track beneath plots trunk BUILD numbers (7871 → 8067) so that "a milestone spans ~22 BUILD numbers instead of ~50" is visible rather than asserted. Data: RC1–RC3, RC17–RC19, RC25–RC31, RC39–RC42, V18, V19, Timeline rows 2010-07 / 2021-03-04 / 2026-03-03 / 2026-09-08.

**F13 — Branch day, both sides.**
A two-column figure. Left, trunk: the MAJOR bump commit at ~20:01 PT, `milestones.py activate` adding `{"155": {...}}` to `milestones.json`, and the regenerated commit-queue/milo/realms configs. Right, the branch: `refs/branch-heads/8059@{#1}` "Create chrome_branch_deps.json for branch 8059.", `@{#2}` "Incrementing VERSION to 155.0.8059.1", `@{#4}` "Update LUCI config for M155" (3,019 files) by `chrome-branch-day@`, and the resulting 256-builder / 30,255-line config against trunk's 1,211 / 139,286, with the `branch_selector` filter drawn as the sieve between them. Data: RC39, RC47–RC49, RC58, RC62–RC63, RS67, RS69, RS82, RS87, RS90, CH70–CH72, V9.

**F14 — How the CI system releases itself.**
Three parallel propagation tracks with their latencies on a common time axis: (a) recipes — commit to `chromium/tools/build` → recipe_bundler → CIPD `refs/heads/main` (0.7–4.2 min), with the recipe autoroller's 10-minute cycle and the trivial (30–110 min) vs nontrivial (hours) landing paths beside it; (b) configs — `infra/config` CL → LUCI Config import (≤10 min window) → consumer crons (1 min) ≈ 1–11 min; (c) binaries — infra/infra commit → `infra-packager-*` → CIPD `latest`, with the reproducible-build note that an unchanged binary re-registers the same instance (210 tag pairs on one instance), and bbagent's separate pinned `version` / `version_canary` (5 % of try builders). Data: CH1–CH39, CH53–CH63, CH76–CH84, V22, Numbers rows for each latency.

### 8.2 Contradictions resolved (R01–R16)

| ID | Contradiction | Resolution and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **R01** | Required-CQ-builder count: LS said "37 `cq: required` / 92 path-based"; IC and CP said 32 required (28 chromium + 4 chrome) / 95 optional. | Both counts are real but answer different questions. `chromium-luci` sets `properties['cq'] = 'required' if not location_filters else 'path-based'` **regardless of `includable_only` or `experiment_percentage`**, so the 37 include includable_only builders (`linux/mac/win-separate-renderer-rel`, `*-webdriver-bidi-rel`), the 5 %-experimental `ios-simulator-exp`, `mega-cq-launcher` and `requires-testing-checker`. Resolution: quote **28 chromium + 4 chrome = 32** from `generated/cq-usage/default.cfg` as the blocking set and describe the `cq` property as a BigQuery tag. Re-counted locally at f288fed6: 37 / 92 / 28 / 4. The 92-vs-95 gap has the same cause (plus R-note C03: includable_only builders are omitted from cq-builders.md). Applied to LS57, the `37 / 92 / 185` Numbers row; new fact V1. |
| **R02** | Pool sizes: LS's Numbers row read "1024 / 490 / 182 / 128" for try / ci / gpu.ci / gpu.try, implying 1,024 try builders against a 500-builder try bucket. | Parsing `cr-buildbucket.cfg` with a state machine shows only **382** builders carry a primary `pool:luci.chromium.try` dimension; the other **642** `pool:` lines sit inside `shadow_builder_adjustments` blocks (led shadows of ci/build/infra builders redirected into the try pool, because `ci.star` sets `shadow_pool = luci.chromium.try` bucket-wide). Resolution: the primary counts are **382 / 490 / 182 / 128**. Applied to the Numbers row; new fact V2. The companion suspicion about the OS counts is **refuted**: shadow blocks only ever carry `builder`, `builderless`, `pool` and `free_space` keys (75 / 75 / 642 / 503) and never `os`, so 812 Ubuntu-22.04 / 131 Mac-26 / 105 Windows-10 are correct primary counts (new fact V3). |
| **R03** | cr-buildbucket.cfg size: "139,286 lines (5.5 MB)" vs "139,286 lines / 5.3 MB". | Same file, different units: **5,544,282 bytes = 5.29 MiB (`ls -lh` prints "5.3M") = 5.54 MB decimal**. Resolution: quote bytes, and give both unit readings when a human-readable size is wanted. Applied to IC100 and three Numbers rows; new fact V4. |
| **R04** | CQ verifier count: IC said the `cq` config group has 603 tryjob verifiers; CP's summary said the `cq` group "lists 604 tryjob builders". | Both counts are right about different scopes: `grep -c 'builders {'` over the whole file = **604**; the `cq` group (from line 15) holds **603**, and the 604th is `chromium/try/requires-testing-checker` in the **`fallback-cq`** group (from line 9412, `fallback: YES` at 9449). CP's attribution of all 604 to the `cq` group is off by one. Verified locally with an `awk` split at line 9412. Applied to CP49 and the `604` Numbers row. |
| **R05** | First commit of a per-build branch: RS said `refs/branch-heads/<BUILD>`'s first commit is "Incrementing VERSION to 156.0.8067.1"; RC and RS's own F68 said commit #1 is "Create chrome_branch_deps.json for branch NNNN." | Verified on gitiles for `refs/branch-heads/8067`: **@{#1} "Create chrome_branch_deps.json for branch 8067." (2026-09-21 12:40:19 UTC)**, @{#2} "Incrementing VERSION to 156.0.8067.1" (12:41:21), @{#3} "…8067.2" (13:38:58), all `Cr-Branched-From main@{#1701636}`. RS67 was wrong and is rewritten. |
| **R06** | Trunk VERSION bump cadence: RS said "Every day"; RC said roughly twice a day (≈03:01 and 14:01 UTC with weekend gaps), and chromium.org says Canary is built twice daily. | Resolution: **"twice on weekdays"**, with gaps on some weekend days; RC's own commit list shows two bumps on both 2026-09-17 and 09-18. Applied to RS67 (same rewrite as R05). |
| **R07** | Identity of the release bot: RC claimed a bot change chrome-release-bot (2017-2021) → "Chrome Release Bot (LUCI)" (2023-2026) → chrome-official-brancher (April 2026); RS attributed 2021 and 2023 commits to chrome-official-brancher. | Verified via the GitHub commits API: **"Chrome Release Bot (LUCI)" is only the author *display name*** of `chrome-official-brancher@chops-service-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — commits 5a03c5f10331 (2021-10-07) and 2168e98b215f (2026-03-31) both carry that e-mail, and around April 2026 (4eb6f6830831, 2026-04-30) only the display string became the bare address. **No account change happened.** The genuinely distinct earlier identity is `chrome-release-bot@chromium.org`, still authoring "Publish DEPS for 94.0.4606.81" on 2021-10-07 while chrome-official-brancher did the VERSION bump one minute earlier. What did change is cadence. Applied to RC41; new fact V10. |

Applied to RS71, RC54 and the Timeline; same resolution as C09; new fact V9. |
| **R09** | Why M144 and M150 are still active branches: RS said "M144 is an extended-stable branch kept alive"; RC attributed both to ChromeOS LTS. | **LTS is the consistent explanation.** chromiumdash gives M144 and M150 ltc/ltr dates (M144 ltc 2026-02-03 / ltr 2026-04-21 / last refresh 2026-10-06; M150 ltc 2026-07-21 / ltr 2026-10-06), V8 keeps 14.4 and 15.0 alive for the same reason, and under the old four-week cadence M144's eight-week Extended Stable window ended around March 2026. Applied to RS84. |
| **R10** | Tree-status hosting: LS presented chromium-status.appspot.com as the live host with a pending migration; CP's glossary wrote "chromium-status.appspot.com (LUCI Tree Status)" and left the relationship open. | **chromium-status.appspot.com is a compatibility facade.** infra/infra's `appengine/chromium_status/appengine_module/chromium_status/status.py:39-40` defines `TREE_STATUS_SERVICE = 'https://luci-tree-status.appspot.com/prpc/luci.tree_status.v1.TreeStatus/'` and proxies GetStatus/ListStatus to it; calling `luci.tree_status.v1.TreeStatus/GetStatus {"name":"trees/chromium/status/latest"}` returns the identical record (createTime 2026-09-20T12:19:05.626463Z, "Tree is open (Automatic: All tree-closer builders are passing)") as `chromium-status.appspot.com/current?format=json`. The canonical store is LUCI Tree Status tree `chromium` (UI ci.chromium.org/ui/tree-status/chromium). Applied to LS93 and the glossary; new fact V11; closes CP open question 3. |
| **R11** | `browser_tests` shards on ci/Linux Tests: LS said 70; IC said 20; only TB explained both. | **Always cite the pair.** 20 is the authored value (`chromium.linux.star:681-696`), 70 is the generated value after `infra/config/autoshard_exceptions.json` is applied at generation time (`generate_buildbot_json.py:1703-1747`); the same file also lifts `blink_web_tests` from 8 to 9. Applied to LS41, IC55 and two Numbers rows; new fact V12; figure F8 exists to make this un-forgettable. |

Confirmed by reading both ranges locally. Applied to LS84 and IC166; new fact V13. |

Project-wide: **55 distinct values, 32 group-less builders**, exactly as IC said. The extra `.star` files (checks, blink.infra, metadata.exporter, chromium.gpu.experimental, …) define builders in other buckets or none on main. Applied to CP80; new fact V14. |

So ~80 directories carry only `gn-args.json`/`targets`, and ~4 bootstrapped builders have no `properties.json` of their own. Applied to LS31; new fact V15; partially closes IC open question 1. |
| **R15** | Who writes Cr-Commit-Position: CP cited `docs/contributing.md` (the git-numberer Gerrit plugin appends it at submit); RS's glossary said the footers are "written by the commit-numbering daemon" with no source. | Use the **documented plugin**. Its README states the rule: every new commit C has at most one parent P, P carries `Cr-Commit-Position: refs/foo/bar@{#X}`, and C gets `@{#X+1}`; a different destination ref yields `@{#1}` plus `Cr-Branched-From`. The "daemon" phrasing is a misnomer for the pre-Gerrit era when `git cl` and the CQ's fork generated footers client-side. Applied to the glossary entry; new fact V16. |

Cite as **source → generated**, not as two files. Applied to LS92 and CP85; new fact V17. |

## 9. Still unverified / open

Grouped by why they are open. Items marked **[closed by verification]** appeared as open questions in a section file and are answered above; they are listed so the explainer does not re-open them.

**Residue of the verification pass itself.**
1. **C10 residue.** The `run_reference_build` verdict states that three details needed fixing; only the first (the core assertion, now verified) survived in the recovered verification record. The other two detail corrections were truncated and are *not* reconstructed here. Anything beyond "no platform sets `run_reference_build`, and the `--run-ref-build` arm described in catapult's dashboard glossary is historical" should be re-verified before publication.
2. **C04 residue.** The re-queried final values for `chromium.tests.gpu`'s COMPLETED and COMPLETED_FAILURE (originally 365,812 / 3,608, both understated for the same sampling reason) were truncated in the recovered record. Use the confirmed totals (created 372,101, DEDUPED 32,329) and re-query the rest.

**Behind an authentication boundary (structurally unanswerable from public data).**
3. The internal `chrome` project's LUCI config: the `chrome.perf` builder list, its scheduler triggering policy, service accounts, and the definitions of `linux-perf-trigger` / `win-perf-trigger`. The "one continuously running tester per platform" shape is an inference from LUCI Scheduler's GREEDY_BATCHING defaults, not a reading of chrome.perf's config.
4. Fleet size of `chrome.tests`, `chrome.tests.finch` and `chrome.tests.intelligence` (internal `chrome-swarming.appspot.com`; `CountBots` refused anonymously on both servers), and of `chromium.tests.oslogin`, the one public-server pool that refuses anonymous counting.
5. The recipe-bundler and recipe-autoroller **builder definitions** (which `-r` repo specs and ref globs are bundled, the exact trigger, the 10-minute schedule). The cadence and per-commit triggering are inferred from Gerrit and CIPD timestamps.
6. Buildbucket's global `settings.cfg` (`services/cr-buildbucket`) with the actual `bbagent_package` `version` / `version_canary` strings; the stable pin was read from a live build instead, and the canary value is unknown.
7. Terraform-declared cron periods for Milo `update-project-configs` and LUCI Notify `update-config`, so their config lag is unquantified (Buildbucket, Scheduler and CV are 1 minute).
8. The internal automation behind `chrome-official-brancher` and `chrome-branch-day` ("Incrementing VERSION", "Updating trunk VERSION", "Create chrome_branch_deps.json", "Roll commits from side projects", go/automate-branch-day); only their git output is observable. Likewise the internal LUCI project running V8's `auto_roll_push`, `auto_tag_ng`, `v8_branch_cut` and `detect_roll_candidate` recipes, and the tool that creates `refs/branch-heads/15.5` from `refs/heads/15.5.35`.
9. The Skia autoroll config for `v8-chromium-autoroll` (skia-autoroll-internal-config, HTTP 403), which is where the `Skip-Performance-Test: false` footer is injected via `ExtraFooters`.
10. chromium/src's Gerrit **label copy conditions** (`/projects/chromium%2Fsrc/labels` returns 403), so whether a Commit-Queue vote survives a developer's own trivial rebase is unverified; and the date chromium/src's submit type became REBASE_ALWAYS (`refs/meta/config` history is not public).
11. Auth-group membership (`chromium-src-increased-quota`, `chromium-src-emergency-quota`) and the current content of chromium's `chromeperf-sheriffs.cfg`.
12. Bug ids 406308794, 428758873, 432644060, 452974519 and b/457822464 (Perf-on-CQ design, whitelist, the Q1-2026 decision) are not anonymously readable.

**Documented nowhere public.**
13. **What "GardenerAI" is.** It appears only in the tree-closure e-mail template ("GardenerAI is currently attempting to identify and revert the culprit") and in `go/irm-gardener-integration`. No public design doc was found.
14. **What TurboCI is, precisely** — work plans, checks, stages, and what `luci.buildbucket.run_in_turboci` changes for a build. `luci-go/turboci` has code but no public README; the observable surface is `CHECK_KIND_SOURCE` / build checks created by depot_tools and tools/build, at 100 % on 234 builders.
15. **The semantics of `Skip-Performance-Test`.** The string appears in **no public repository** (GitHub code search over chromium, skia-buildbot, catapult, v8, luci-go, recipes-py returns 0 hits) and in none of the local checkouts. Whether `true` opts out, `false` forces a job, or a missing footer is the default is unknown, and the ten V8 rolls of 2026-09-20..22 that carry it produced **no visible CQ Perf Pinpoint job** while 173 human-owned CLs did. The selection rule that picks the ~5 % of CLs that get a CQ Perf job (≈100 of 2,200 in July 2025) is likewise not public; the sample suggests path-based selection (blink renderer, fieldtrial config, media, content).
